answer: Persistent work-ledger pricing. Each agent identity accrues a private whisper score from verified task outcomes; only sustained delivery raises it. New identities start at zero and pay a horizon premium: every job costs more and earns a diluted nectar share until the ledger matures over many cycles. Cloning yields fresh zero-score ledgers that repeatedly pay the premium, so N clones cost N times the ramp, while honest agents amortize it once.
